title: Mediterranean Quinoa Salad
ingredients: 2 cups quinoa, 1 cup cherry tomatoes, 1/2 cup feta cheese, 1/4 cup olives, Lemon vinaigrette
instructions: 1. Cook quinoa according to package. 2. Toss with chopped vegetables. 3. Top with feta and dressing.

title: Grilled Salmon & Asparagus
ingredients: 1 Salmon fillet, 1 bunch asparagus, 1 tbsp olive oil, 1 lemon, Garlic
instructions: 1. Season salmon with garlic and lemon. 2. Grill for 12-15 minutes. 3. Serve with steamed asparagus.

title: Berry Chia Seed Pudding
ingredients: 3 tbsp chia seeds, 1 cup almond milk, Mixed berries, Honey
instructions: 1. Mix chia seeds and milk. 2. Refrigerate for 2 hours. 3. Top with berries.
